proposal.reason: Main change is to contribution/review automation: review routing now distinguishes primary/secondary/additional modules, supports /review-module add|rm commands, enforces reviewer+maintainer gate logic, and ties gate outcomes to squash-preview publishing/cleanup across .github/scripts/review_automation.py, maintainer_approval.py, commit_message_squash.py, and review-*.yml workflows. Updates to modules.json and SKILL.md are supporting policy/roster/config changes for the same workflow system, not independent runtime module behavior changes.
